newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dransfield to place 77 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Dransfield to place 77 mln new shares.

text.p: Dransfield Holdings Ltd said it would place 77.05 million new shares to associates of chairman Kenneth Fung and deputy chairman Horace Yao, raising HK$38.50 million to reduce borrowing and strengthen capital base.

The electronics appliances distributor said Dransfield Holdings (International) Ltd, Grandom Inc, Grandom Overseas Ltd and Grandom Asia Trading Ltd, which are associate companies of Fung and Yao, had agreed to place 36 million existing Dransfield shares to third party at HK$0.51 per share.
They will subscribe to 77.05 million new shares at a price equal to the net placement price after expenses, it said.
Dransfield shares ended at HK$0.50 a share on Thursday.
On completion of the deal, aggregate shareholding of the four associates and Yao in Dransfield will remain unchanged at 53.27 percent, it said.
